unit.edax10: One D10 full-window all-alternative root query, single native thread, including evaluation loading
unit.edax12: One D12 full-window all-alternative root query, single native thread, including evaluation loading
unit.B: One root searched at both D4 and D6 with unchanged production B alpha-beta
unit.exact: One root solved for every alternative under both raw-disc and awarded-empty conventions
unit.linear: One complete converged 21-coefficient fit from zero, feature encoding, packing and durable receipt
unit.pattern: One complete converged 10932-coefficient compact pattern fit from zero, fixed engineering L, encoding, packing and durable receipt

plan.scheduling: Index modulo the 16 roots or 8 exact endings; fits repeat the identical small engineering corpus. Rotate worker-count and kind order by repetition. No per-machine duration calibration or sample resizing.

fitting.independence: Replicate the same 591 preferences exactly 16 times to exercise encoding/optimization; 9456 rows, 15 informative original roots, no new evidence or strength sample

plan.timing: Cold complete task subprocesses; includes imports and scientific input reads, child startup, encoding/optimization, full model packing, JSON, fsync/rename/directory fsync, pool orchestration and sampled telemetry. Build and correctness gates separately reported.
plan.publication: Engineering fixtures and replicas only; no independent strength sample, model promotion, private corpus or historical checkpoints. Do not extrapolate tiny fits to memory-bound multi-gigabyte training.

portability.reason: Round aligned_alloc byte size up; logical hash entries/search unchanged
